It also applies a local patch to remove hardcoded compiler flags, which is a common packaging adjustment. No network access occurs during build or package phases, and all operations are confined to the build directory and `$pkgdir`.

There are no signs of obfuscated code, unauthorized downloads, data exfiltration, or execution of external scripts. The package follows standard AUR packaging practices and appears to faithfully reproduce the upstream Nim toolchain without malicious modifications.
